weather_report:
As the night drapes a soft, muted veil over Downtown San Francisco, the air carries a pleasant coolness, settling in at about fifty-seven degrees. The remnants of a partly cloudy sky lend an almost tranquil beauty to the atmosphere, with a gentle west-southwest wind whispering through the streets. Morning will awaken to an expanse of blue, as sunlight breaks through to kiss the city with a high of sixty-seven degrees. The vibrant intensity of a sunny day beckons with winds stirring, their playful gusts inviting one to embrace the outdoors.

With this delightful forecast, one might consider dressing in layers to harmonize with the shifting temperatures—from a light sweater for the cool morning to a comfortable shirt for the afternoon sun. Perhaps a leisurely stroll along the waterfront could provide serenity, or an afternoon spent sipping coffee at a local café, basking in the warmth and watching the lively city move. The absence of fog and the anticipated bright clarity paint a perfect picture to enjoy the charm of San Francisco without the heaviness of the marine layer. As the sun rises, it promises a splendid day beckoning adventure and quiet reflection alike.
